Certainly! Here are two hints for the given step:

Hint 1: Consider the properties of one-hot encoding. When you one-hot encode a categorical variable with two categories, the resulting columns are linearly dependent. This means that one column can be expressed as a linear combination of the other.

Hint 2: For a matrix to be invertible, it must be full rank, meaning all its columns must be linearly independent. Think about whether the columns of $\Phi_1$ are linearly independent given the one-hot encoding of the sex column.
